correctness.rationale: Every square root fixes u and its nonroot vertices have depth one or two. Its induced map has the same depth bound with root block 0. For a prescribed admissible map, the k chosen nonroot direct preimages in C_0 are the only targets for remaining points of C_0 and for points mapping into C_0 but not directly to u. In each nonroot first-layer block, the h direct preimages of u are precisely the allowable destinations of all its incoming second-layer blocks; this gives the factor h^N_j with no duplication. Mapping whole first-layer blocks to u shows every admissible map occurs. Splitting by the first-layer indices gives the claimed support count, and the two-block factor follows by the binomial theorem. The uniqueness cases and all their complements follow from existence or impossibility of a block-preserving chain of length two on distinct vertices. An independent exact depth-color enumeration agreed fiber by fiber on ten profiles, including the seven-point four-block profile (2,1,2,2), with 10 fibers and 117 roots.
residual_risks: The finite enumeration is corroboration; the argument for every finite partition is the counting bijection.

evidence: The indexed recurrence holds for arbitrary prescribed block characters, unequal sizes and all heights. Higgins treats full transformations, while the two partition-monoid papers concern generation or idempotents.
broader_coverage.reasoning: The broader height enumeration applies to exactly the same labeled and partition-preserving setting; the other primary sources establish background, not the decisive implication.

evidence: For an admissible e only block 0 is fixed. The indexed forest EGF is exp(T_0^[2]); its single-tree part is T_0^[2]. The labeled coefficient multiplied by the block factorials and divided by n_0 gives the number with the specified root u by label symmetry.

Write F={j>0:e(j)=0}. The recurrence gives T_0^[2]=x_0 exp(x_0 exp(x_0+sum_{j in F}x_j) + sum_{j in F}x_j exp(sum_{i:e(i)=j}x_i)). Expanding the exponential terms indexed by k and h_j and taking the labeled coefficient gives precisely the displayed k and h_j sums, including h_j^N_j. Inadmissible e cannot carry a height-two tree with root in block 0.
claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: This is a direct specialization and expansion of the earlier-comparison result, not reliance on a title or on the statement that the earlier enumeration happens to include some of the same maps. The support count, two-block reduction and uniqueness statement are elementary consequences.

Its one-component term at height two gives precisely the claimed fiber, not just a loose superset. This is demonstrable coverage, without inferring historical priority from a shared index date.
